description: Mobile (Expo): adjuntar hasta 3 fotos de respaldo al registrar un pago en el modal de apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/payments.tsx (flujo admin/supervisor 'pago por mano'), reusando el componente PhotoCapture y un helper nuevo payment-evidence.ts espejo de picking-evidence.ts; y mostrar thumbnails con URL firmada en el detalle expandido del pago. Todo bajo el flag payment_photo_evidence. Depende de FEAT-001 (bucket, tabla, flag, constantes @fundo360/shared). Independiente de FEAT-003 (web).
steps: Crear apps/mobile/src/lib/payment-evidence.ts como espejo de apps/mobile/src/lib/picking-evidence.ts: importar { PAYMENT_EVIDENCE } de '@fundo360/shared' y usar BUCKET=PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.BUCKET; reusar currentOrgId() y newUuid() importándolos de './picking-evidence' (no re-implementar la lectura del JWT); evidencePath(orgId, paymentId, uuid) => `${orgId}/${paymentId}/${uuid}.jpg`; uploadPaymentEvidence({orgId, paymentId, localUri}): fetch(localUri)->arrayBuffer()->supabase.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(path, buf, {contentType:'image/jpeg', upsert:false}); devuelve path. signedPaymentEvidenceUrl(path, expiresInSeconds=3600) con createSignedUrl.

En apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/payments.tsx: importar { useFeatureFlag } from '../../src/hooks/useFeatureFlag', { PhotoCapture } from '../../src/components/PhotoCapture', { PAYMENT_EVIDENCE } from '@fundo360/shared', y las funciones de ../../src/lib/payment-evidence. Añadir const { enabled: photoEnabled } = useFeatureFlag('payment_photo_evidence').

Añadir estado en PaymentsScreen: const [photoUris, setPhotoUris] = useState<string[]>([]) y const [showPhoto, setShowPhoto] = useState(false). Al cerrar/abrir el payModal y en onSuccess de payMutation, limpiar photoUris y showPhoto (igual que se limpia payAmount/payNotes).

En el modal 'Registrar Pago' (solo cuando photoEnabled), añadir un bloque 'Fotos de respaldo (opcional, máx 3)': botón 'Agregar foto' que hace setShowPhoto(true), deshabilitado cuando photoUris.length>=PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.MAX_IMAGES; thumbnails con <Image> de cada uri y acción 'Quitar' (filtra el arreglo). Patrón visual tomado del bloque de foto de apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/register.tsx.

Renderizar <PhotoCapture onCapture={(uri)=>{ setPhotoUris(p=>[...p, uri].slice(0, PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.MAX_IMAGES)); setShowPhoto(false); }} onClose={()=>setShowPhoto(false)} /> cuando showPhoto es true (igual que register.tsx retorna PhotoCapture antes del resto de la UI, adaptado a que aquí es un Modal).

En payMutation, SOLO en la rama online: cambiar el insert del pago a const { data: inserted, error } = await supabase.from('payments').insert({...}).select('id').single(); mantener el update de status del settlement EXACTAMENTE como hoy (no tocar la lógica pending/partial/paid ni la inmutabilidad del settlement pagado). Tras ello, si photoEnabled && photoUris.length>0: obtener orgId=await currentOrgId(); por cada uri subir con uploadPaymentEvidence({orgId, paymentId: inserted.id, localUri: uri}) y luego supabase.from('payment_photo_evidence').insert({ payment_id: inserted.id, image_path: path, uploaded_by: worker!.id }). Best-effort: envolver cada foto en try/catch; si alguna falla, NO revertir el pago, acumular un flag para avisar.

Comportamiento offline sin cambios: la rama offline (enqueue payment_insert) NO sube fotos; si había photoUris, al terminar mostrar showAlert indicando que las fotos requieren conexión (mismo criterio que register.tsx photoSkippedOffline). Documentarlo en comentario.
En onSuccess/onError mantener los showAlert actuales; añadir un showAlert extra si alguna foto falló al subir ('El pago se registró; una foto no se pudo adjuntar.').

En el detalle expandido del pago (expandedId===item.id), cuando photoEnabled: hacer un query (TanStack useQuery con enabled=photoEnabled && expandedId===item.id) a supabase.from('payment_photo_evidence').select('payment_id, image_path').in('payment_id', item.payments.map(p=>p.id)), resolver signedPaymentEvidenceUrl para cada image_path y renderizar thumbnails con <Image> agrupados por payment_id. Mantener la UI simple y consistente con los estilos existentes de payments.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` (desde la raíz del worktree) pasa sin errores de tipos en apps/mobile (expo typecheck) con los cambios.
Con el flag OFF, el bloque de fotos NO se renderiza y el registro de pago funciona exactamente como hoy (degradación limpia).

Con el flag ON, se pueden adjuntar hasta 3 fotos (el botón 'Agregar' se deshabilita en 3) y, al pagar online, se crean filas en payment_photo_evidence con uploaded_by=worker.id; una falla de subida no revierte el pago.
No se modifica la lógica de status del settlement ni la rama offline del pago.
verification: npm run build  (desde la raíz del worktree; debe pasar expo typecheck de apps/mobile)
Revisión manual del código: el bloque de fotos está gateado por photoEnabled; límite 3 aplicado en cliente; subida best-effort; prueba de cámara en device anotada como manual (no automatizable)
findings:
COMPLETED.

NEW HELPER apps/mobile/src/lib/payment-evidence.ts (mirror of picking-evidence.ts): imports PAYMENT_EVIDENCE from @fundo360/shared and BUCKET = PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.BUCKET ('payment-evidence'). Reuses newUuid from './picking-evidence'. NOTE: currentOrgId is NOT re-imported inside this helper (it is used directly in payments.tsx); importing it here but unused would be dead code, so it stays imported from './picking-evidence' at the call site. Exports: evidencePath(orgId, paymentId, uuid) => `${orgId}/${paymentId}/${uuid}.jpg`; uploadPaymentEvidence({orgId, paymentId, localUri}) -> fetch(localUri).arrayBuffer() -> supabase.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(path, buf, {contentType:'image/jpeg', upsert:false}) returns path; signedPaymentEvidenceUrl(path, expiresInSeconds=3600) via createSignedUrl.

WIRING apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/payments.tsx:
- Imports added: PAYMENT_EVIDENCE (@fundo360/shared), useFeatureFlag, PhotoCapture, currentOrgId (from picking-evidence), uploadPaymentEvidence+signedPaymentEvidenceUrl (payment-evidence), Image (react-native).
- const { enabled: photoEnabled } = useFeatureFlag('payment_photo_evidence').
- State: photoUris: string[] and showPhoto: boolean. Added closePayModal() that clears payModal/payAmount/payNotes/photoUris/showPhoto; used by overlay tap, Cancel button, and payMutation onSuccess. The Pay button onPress also resets payNotes/photoUris/showPhoto when opening.
- payMutation ONLINE branch: insert changed to `.insert({...}).select('id').single()`; the settlement status update (pending/partial/paid) is BYTE-FOR-BYTE unchanged. After the status update, if photoEnabled && photoUris.length>0 && inserted.id: orgId = await currentOrgId(); for each uri -> uploadPaymentEvidence then supabase.from('payment_photo_evidence').insert({payment_id: inserted.id, image_path: path, uploaded_by: worker.id}); each wrapped in try/catch (and insert error checked) -> photoFailed flag; a failure NEVER reverts the payment. Returns {queued:false, photoFailed, photoSkippedOffline:false}.
- OFFLINE branch unchanged (enqueue payment_insert, no photos); returns photoSkippedOffline = photoEnabled && photoUris.length>0 so onSuccess can warn.
- onSuccess: keeps original 'Pago registrado/en espera' alert; adds a 'Fotos no adjuntadas' alert when photoSkippedOffline and a 'Foto no adjuntada' alert when photoFailed; invalidates ['payment-evidence'] too.
- UI modal: new block (only when photoEnabled) 'Fotos de respaldo (opcional, máx 3)' with thumbnails + per-photo 'Quitar' and an 'Agregar foto' button disabled at PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.MAX_IMAGES. PhotoCapture rendered inside a full-screen <Modal visible={showPhoto}>; onCapture pushes uri and slices to MAX_IMAGES.
- Expanded detail: new module-level component PaymentEvidenceThumbnails (TanStack useQuery, enabled only when photoEnabled && card expanded) queries payment_photo_evidence by in(payment_ids), resolves signedPaymentEvidenceUrl per image_path, groups by payment_id and renders <Image> thumbnails.

NOT TOUCHED: settlement status logic / prevent_paid_settlement_update immutability; the offline payment branch; no Edge Functions created. payments.amount and all calculations unchanged.

VERIFICATION:
- Mobile has NO 'build' script, so `turbo build` (root `npm run build`) only runs @fundo360/web (PASS, exit 0). Mobile expo typecheck was run SEPARATELY: `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` -> PASS (exit 0, no output) under strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
- ROOT-CAUSE NOTE for convergence: the worktree had NO node_modules, so `@fundo360/shared` resolved via the PARENT checkout's symlink (to the parent's packages/shared, which lacks FEAT-001's PAYMENT_EVIDENCE) and tsc failed with TS2305. Fixed by running `npm install` INSIDE the worktree once, which created worktree-local node_modules/@fundo360/shared -> ../../packages/shared (the worktree's). Any later agent typechecking mobile in this worktree must ensure worktree-local node_modules exist (run `npm install` in the worktree) or the shared contract will resolve to the wrong copy.
- Camera capture on a physical Android/iOS device is MANUAL (expo-camera via PhotoCapture, OTA-friendly, no native rebuild): not automatable here. Suggested manual check: flag ON -> add up to 3 photos (button disables at 3), pay online -> rows appear in payment_photo_evidence with uploaded_by=worker.id and thumbnails show in the expanded detail; flag OFF -> photo block hidden and payment works as before.
